name: dropdown_filter
prompt: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8765/?scenario=dropdown_filter and extract the title and category for every document item. Use the category dropdown filter to iterate through all 4 categories. Save each item to save_record with the source URL. Deduplicate by URL.

expected.description: 20 unique records across 4 filter categories, each with title and category non-null.

description: A select dropdown with 4 options. Each option changes the item list. Tests select_filter_value, filter iteration, and dedup.
